info.title: Decisions API
info.description: OpenAI Decisions and TypeSafe System One.

post.description: OpenAI Decisions format: input plus a questions array; answers preserve question order. Supports predicate, choice, score and refusal. Endpoint metadata can route to TypeSafe Jev. Cross-protocol question names must be unique; choice values that collide as map keys are rejected. For TypeSafe models, requests are converted to the TypeSafe protocol and sent to upstream /v1/systemone; responses are converted back to OpenAI Decisions format.

model.description: Model ID, e.g. openai/gpt-6-luna or typesafe/jev-latest. Availability depends on catalog and account configuration.

usage.description: Supports native input_tokens/output_tokens and compatible prompt_tokens/completion_tokens; upstream field names are preserved.

post.description: Native TypeSafe format: state plus a questions map; answers are keyed by question name. noul corresponds to OpenAI predicate. Endpoint metadata can route to OpenAI Decisions. Structured state/instructions/criteria are preserved as JSON text during conversion. Cross-protocol OpenAI refusals use a type=refusal extension.
